assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: cinematic four-panel story strip, one tall 1:2 image made of FOUR equal-width horizontal widescreen scenes stacked vertically.
Input image: style, composition, environments, and panel-story reference.
Primary request: create a new version of this hospital drama storyboard with the same scene progression and quality, featuring Pamela as a mixed Black-and-white woman in her late thirties: warm medium-brown skin, shoulder-length loose dark brown curls, brown eyes, oval face. Keep her face, hair, clothing and body consistent in all four shots. Keep the four shots distinct and divided by straight edge-to-edge horizontal cuts.
Scene 1 top: Pamela sitting at a clinician's desk, pen above the consent form for planned spleen surgery, listening cautiously to a middle-aged male surgeon explaining.
Scene 2: weeks later, same Pamela in a clinic, one hand holding her abdomen, visibly exhausted and uncomfortable, same male surgeon turning away dismissively.
Scene 3: same Pamela and an independent woman specialist studying an ultrasound screen together; specialist indicates the scan and has documents, Pamela processing troubling findings.
Scene 4 bottom: same Pamela at a desk with a female advocate, comparing original consent form and medical records, determined and focused.
Style: sophisticated photoreal live-action hospital drama stills, natural skin texture, understated emotional expressions, shallow depth of field, cool soft blue-grey clinic light, warm practical desk lamps in final scene. Match the visual quality of the supplied strip. Modest fully clothed adults, no surgery depicted, no injuries, no blood, no medical procedure shown.
Constraints: exactly FOUR stacked scenes in one tall image; no text, captions, letters, readable words, signage, brand names or logos; keep faces comfortably framed and retain storytelling detail. This is fictional drama.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: cinematic three-panel hospital drama story strip, one tall 2:3 image made of THREE stacked horizontal widescreen scenes, straight horizontal boundaries.
Input image: shot composition and style reference for the existing Jonah story strip.
Primary request: preserve the clinic environments, props, emotional progression, camera framing, shot order and cinematic photographic quality. Change Jonah, the elderly patient who appears in all three panels, to a Chinese man in his late sixties with warm light-medium skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, gentle age lines, brown eyes and a clean shaven face. Make him clearly the same person in every shot, wearing the same olive brown jacket over a charcoal shirt. Other supporting adults can stay as in the reference.
Exact top-to-bottom story:
1. Jonah at a clinic desk talking trustingly with a woman doctor in white coat, medical folders and capped blood-sample tubes on desk; caring conversational scene.
2. Jonah sits fatigued in a clinic chair while that same doctor enters research notes at a desk in the background. He is weary and concerned, no procedures being performed.
3. Jonah and a woman advocate lean over open medical records together at a desk, finding a troubling withheld-treatment instruction in the file, Jonah points to the page with concerned determination.
Style: sophisticated photoreal live-action hospital drama stills, realistic human faces and hands, natural subtle emotions, soft cool hospital light, shallow depth of field, restrained warmer practical lamps in final frame. Modest fully clothed adults. Exactly three stacked wide scenes.
Constraints: no readable text, captions, logos, letters, signs, watermarks; no weapons, injuries, blood or graphic content. Keep everything physically plausible and consistent.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: cinematic three-panel story strip for a fictional hospital drama; one tall 2:3 image containing exactly THREE horizontal widescreen scenes, stacked vertically.
Input image: style, scene composition, props, setting, framing, and continuous story reference for Isabella.
Primary request: keep all three existing scene beats, hospital environment and sophisticated cinematic photoreal quality, but portray Isabella consistently as a Black woman around fifty with deep brown skin, short natural tightly coiled salt-and-pepper hair, brown eyes and a thoughtful expressive face. Keep her blue wrap/scarf over a cream long-sleeved top, and use the same face, hair, skin tone and proportions in every panel.
Top scene: Isabella listening to a middle-aged male neurologist with glasses in his office; he explains a research program, brain scans on monitor and a brain model on the desk. Isabella is concerned but hopeful.
Middle scene: Isabella at a desk reading study documents and suspension records, a laptop and medical folders nearby. She looks deeply troubled by what the paperwork reveals.
Bottom scene: Isabella and a woman advocate comparing study records and copies of the suspension notice together at a desk, determined to understand the concealed information.
Style: photoreal dramatic film stills, realistic skin, restrained human expressions, cool blue-grey clinic daylight, shallow depth of field, warm practical desk lamps, matching the supplied reference's lighting and polish. Keep modest fully clothed adults, only office conversations and paperwork.
Constraints: exactly THREE stacked scenes separated by straight edge-to-edge cuts, no extra panels, no text, captions, readable letters, signs, logos, watermarks, weapons, violence, injuries or graphic medical material.
